name: mem
label: Mem
description: Capture and organize your thoughts using Mem.ai

token.label: API Key
token.description: Create an API key in Mem under **Settings → API** and paste it here.

create_mem.label: Create Mem
create_mem.description: Send raw content to Mem so it can process and file it for you. Returns only a request ID; the note appears in Mem a few seconds later.

input.label: Input
input.description: Raw content to remember, such as HTML, an email, a transcript or a simple note.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.description: Optional guidance on how Mem should process or remember this content.

context.label: Context
context.description: Additional background that relates this content to your existing knowledge.

timestamp.label: Timestamp
timestamp.description: When the content was captured. Defaults to now.

create_note.label: Create Note
create_note.description: Create a Markdown note in Mem, optionally adding it to existing collections.

content.label: Content
content.description: Markdown content (up to 200,000 characters). The first line becomes the note title.

id.label: Note ID
id.description: Optional UUID for the new note. Mem returns a 409 conflict if a note with this ID already exists.

add_to_collections.label: Add to Collections
add_to_collections.description: Existing collection IDs or exact collection titles. Titles that match no collection are ignored; collections are not created.

created_at.label: Created At
created_at.description: Optional creation timestamp for the note. Defaults to now.

get_note.label: Get Note
get_note.description: Get the full content and details of a note by ID.

note_id.label: Note ID
note_id.description: The ID of the note to read. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.

list_notes.label: List Notes
list_notes.description: List notes in chronological order, with optional collection, date and content filters.

collection_id.label: Collection
collection_id.description: Only list notes in this collection.

order_by.label: Order By
order_by.description: Which timestamp to sort by. Defaults to Updated At.

created_after.label: Created After
created_after.description: Only include items created at or after this time (inclusive).

created_before.label: Created Before
created_before.description: Only include items created at or before this time (inclusive).

updated_after.label: Updated After
updated_after.description: Only include items updated at or after this time (inclusive).

updated_before.label: Updated Before
updated_before.description: Only include items updated at or before this time (inclusive).

contains_open_tasks.label: Contains Open Tasks
contains_open_tasks.description: Pick Yes to return only notes with open tasks. Leave empty to include all notes.

contains_tasks.label: Contains Tasks
contains_tasks.description: Pick Yes to return only notes with any tasks. Leave empty to include all notes.

contains_images.label: Contains Images
contains_images.description: Pick Yes to return only notes with images. Leave empty to include all notes.

contains_files.label: Contains Files
contains_files.description: Pick Yes to return only notes with files. Leave empty to include all notes.

include_note_content.label: Include Note Content
include_note_content.description: Return the full Markdown content of each note.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Notes per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

page.label: Page Cursor
page.description: The next_page value from a previous call.

search_notes.label: Search Notes
search_notes.description: Search notes by text, ranked by relevance, with optional filters.

collection_ids.label: Collection IDs
collection_ids.description: Only return notes in any of these collections.

created_after.label: Created After
created_after.description: Only include items created at or after this time (inclusive).

created_before.label: Created Before
created_before.description: Only include items created at or before this time (inclusive).

updated_after.label: Updated After
updated_after.description: Only include items updated at or after this time (inclusive).

updated_before.label: Updated Before
updated_before.description: Only include items updated at or before this time (inclusive).

contains_open_tasks.label: Contains Open Tasks
contains_open_tasks.description: Pick Yes to return only notes with open tasks. Leave empty to include all notes.

contains_tasks.label: Contains Tasks
contains_tasks.description: Pick Yes to return only notes with any tasks. Leave empty to include all notes.

contains_images.label: Contains Images
contains_images.description: Pick Yes to return only notes with images. Leave empty to include all notes.

contains_files.label: Contains Files
contains_files.description: Pick Yes to return only notes with files. Leave empty to include all notes.

include_note_content.label: Include Note Content
include_note_content.description: Return the full Markdown content of each note.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of results to skip (zero-based). Requires Snapshot ID when above 0.

snapshot_id.label: Snapshot ID
snapshot_id.description: The snapshot_id from a previous search, for later pages.

find_related_notes.label: Find Related Notes
find_related_notes.description: Find notes semantically related to a given note.

note_id.label: Note ID
note_id.description: The ID of the source note. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum related notes to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

update_note.label: Update Note
update_note.description: Replace the full content of a note. The first line becomes the new title.

note_id.label: Note ID
note_id.description: The ID of the note to update. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.

content.label: Content
content.description: The complete new Markdown body. It replaces the existing content.

version.label: Version
version.description: Current note version from Get Note. Leave empty to fetch it automatically.

updated_at.label: Updated At
updated_at.description: Optional last-updated timestamp. Defaults to now.

set_note_created_at.label: Set Note Created At
set_note_created_at.description: Backdate the visible creation time of a note without changing its content.

note_id.label: Note ID
note_id.description: The ID of the note to backdate. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.

created_at.label: Created At
created_at.description: New creation time. Must be in the past and earlier than the original creation time.

trash_note.label: Trash Note
trash_note.description: Move a note to the trash. It can be brought back with Restore Note.

note_id.label: Note ID
note_id.description: The ID of the note to move to the trash. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.

restore_note.label: Restore Note
restore_note.description: Bring a note back from the trash.

note_id.label: Note ID
note_id.description: The ID of the trashed note to restore. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.

delete_note.label: Delete Note
delete_note.description: Permanently delete a note. It cannot be restored; use Trash Note for a recoverable removal.

note_id.label: Note ID
note_id.description: The ID of the note to delete permanently. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.

create_collection.label: Create Collection
create_collection.description: Create a new collection to group notes.

get_collection.label: Get Collection
get_collection.description: Get the details of a collection.

list_collections.label: List Collections
list_collections.description: List collections in chronological order, with optional date filters.

order_by.label: Order By
order_by.description: Which timestamp to sort by. Defaults to Updated At.

created_after.label: Created After
created_after.description: Only include items created at or after this time (inclusive).

created_before.label: Created Before
created_before.description: Only include items created at or before this time (inclusive).

updated_after.label: Updated After
updated_after.description: Only include items updated at or after this time (inclusive).

updated_before.label: Updated Before
updated_before.description: Only include items updated at or before this time (inclusive).

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Collections per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

page.label: Page Cursor
page.description: The next_page value from a previous call.

search_collections.label: Search Collections
search_collections.description: Search collections by text, ranked by relevance.

query.label: Query
query.description: Free-text query. Leave empty to match all collections.

created_after.label: Created After
created_after.description: Only include items created at or after this time (inclusive).

created_before.label: Created Before
created_before.description: Only include items created at or before this time (inclusive).

updated_after.label: Updated After
updated_after.description: Only include items updated at or after this time (inclusive).

updated_before.label: Updated Before
updated_before.description: Only include items updated at or before this time (inclusive).

update_collection.label: Update Collection
update_collection.description: Rename a collection or change its description.

title.label: Title
title.description: New title. Leave empty to keep the current one.

description.label: Description
description.description: New description. Leave empty to keep the current one.

add_note_to_collection.label: Add Note to Collection
add_note_to_collection.description: Add an existing note to an existing collection.

collection_id.label: Collection
collection_id.description: The collection to add the note to.

note_id.label: Note ID
note_id.description: The ID of the note to add. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.

remove_note_from_collection.label: Remove Note from Collection
remove_note_from_collection.description: Remove a note from a collection. Both the note and the collection are kept.

collection_id.label: Collection
collection_id.description: The collection to remove the note from.

note_id.label: Note ID
note_id.description: The ID of the note to remove. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.

move_note.label: Move Note
move_note.description: Move a note from one collection to another.

source_collection_id.label: Source Collection
source_collection_id.description: The collection that currently contains the note.

target_collection_id.label: Target Collection
target_collection_id.description: The collection to move the note to.

note_id.label: Note ID
note_id.description: The ID of the note to move. Find it with List Notes or Search Notes, or map it from a previous step.

delete_collection.label: Delete Collection
delete_collection.description: Permanently delete a collection. Its notes are not deleted.
